final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and n // (out + 1) < out + 1
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(1) == 1
  ex isqrt(17) == 4
  ex isqrt(25) == 5
  var lo = 0
  var hi = 3037000500
  while hi - lo > 1
    let mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
    if mid <= n // mid
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid
  lo
